label: BCU Combined
info:
BCU Combined Flow - All BCU CAN parsers in one flow

Includes:
- Chiller State (0x18008040x, 0x18018040x)
- Chiller Alarm (0x18068040x, 0x18078040x)
- Container Battery State (0x18FF1xF0)
- Container Battery Fault (0x18FF16F0)
- HVCU Control State (0x18FF201x)

name: Parse Chiller State
Parse Chiller Alarm
Parse Container Battery State
Parse Container Battery Fault
func:
const frame = msg.payload || msg;
let canId = frame.canid & 0x1FFFFFFF;
const data = frame.data || [];

if (canId !== 0x18FF16F0) {
    return null;
}

function getBit(buf, bitIndex) {
    const byteIndex = Math.floor(bitIndex / 8);
    const bitOffset = bitIndex % 8;
    return ((buf[byteIndex] >> bitOffset) & 0x01) === 1;
}

let state = {
    kind: "ContainerBatteryFaultState",
    version: 1,
    timestampUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
    faultPackWarning: getBit(data, 0),
    faultPackDanger: getBit(data, 1),
    faultCellOverVoltageWarning: getBit(data, 2),
    faultCellOverVoltageDanger: getBit(data, 3),
    faultCellUnderVoltageWarning: getBit(data, 4),
    faultCellUnderVoltageDanger: getBit(data, 5),
    faultCellOverTempWarning: getBit(data, 6),
    faultCellOverTempDanger: getBit(data, 7),
    faultCellUnderTempWarning: getBit(data, 8),
    faultCellUnderTempDanger: getBit(data, 9),
    warningPackOC: getBit(data, 10),
    faultPackOC: getBit(data, 11),
    faultPackCurrentSensor: getBit(data, 12),
    faultPackDischargeContactor: getBit(data, 13),
    faultPackChargeContactor: getBit(data, 14),
    faultFuse: getBit(data, 15),
    faultPackHVIL2: getBit(data, 16),
    faultPackFuse: getBit(data, 17),
    faultPackFireWarningSensor: getBit(data, 18),
    faultPackHighHumidity: getBit(data, 19),
    faultPackBMU: getBit(data, 20),
    faultPackNegContactor: getBit(data, 21),
    faultPackPrecharge: getBit(data, 22),
    faultIsolation: getBit(data, 23),
    faultPackEmergency: getBit(data, 24),
    warningModuleTempBalance: getBit(data, 25),
    faultModuleTempBalance: getBit(data, 26),
    faultDeadCell: getBit(data, 32),
    faultCANCommunication: getBit(data, 33),
    faultPackIntCommunication: getBit(data, 34),
    faultInternalMeasurement: getBit(data, 35),
    faultVoltageRedundancy: getBit(data, 36),
    faultOpenWire: getBit(data, 37),
    faultBoardBMUNoResponse: getBit(data, 40),
    faultBoardStackInitialize: getBit(data, 41),
    faultBoardMeasurement: getBit(data, 42),
    faultBoardStackConfiguration: getBit(data, 43),
    faultBoardBalance: getBit(data, 44),
    faultBoardOperationSystem: getBit(data, 45),
    faultBoardGPI: getBit(data, 48),
    faultBoardChip: getBit(data, 49),
    faultBoardSys: getBit(data, 50),
    faultBoardCommunication: getBit(data, 51),
    faultBoardCompOverVoltage: getBit(data, 52),
    faultBoardCompUnderVoltage: getBit(data, 53),
    faultBoardAuxOverVoltage: getBit(data, 54),
    faultBoardAuxUnderVoltage: getBit(data, 55),
    faultBoardOverVoltage: getBit(data, 56),
    faultBoardUnderVoltage: getBit(data, 57),
    faultBoardStackError: getBit(data, 58),
    faultBoardOpenWireDetect: getBit(data, 59)
};

const warningFlags = [
    'faultPackWarning', 'faultCellOverVoltageWarning', 'faultCellUnderVoltageWarning',
    'faultCellOverTempWarning', 'faultCellUnderTempWarning', 'warningPackOC', 'warningModuleTempBalance'
];

const faultFlags = [
    'faultPackDanger', 'faultCellOverVoltageDanger', 'faultCellUnderVoltageDanger',
    'faultCellOverTempDanger', 'faultCellUnderTempDanger', 'faultPackOC',
    'faultPackCurrentSensor', 'faultPackDischargeContactor', 'faultPackChargeContactor',
    'faultFuse', 'faultPackHVIL2', 'faultPackFuse', 'faultPackFireWarningSensor',
    'faultPackHighHumidity', 'faultPackBMU', 'faultPackNegContactor', 'faultPackPrecharge',
    'faultIsolation', 'faultPackEmergency', 'faultModuleTempBalance', 'faultDeadCell',
    'faultCANCommunication', 'faultPackIntCommunication', 'faultInternalMeasurement',
    'faultVoltageRedundancy', 'faultOpenWire', 'faultBoardBMUNoResponse',
    'faultBoardStackInitialize', 'faultBoardMeasurement', 'faultBoardStackConfiguration',
    'faultBoardBalance', 'faultBoardOperationSystem', 'faultBoardGPI', 'faultBoardChip',
    'faultBoardSys', 'faultBoardCommunication', 'faultBoardCompOverVoltage',
    'faultBoardCompUnderVoltage', 'faultBoardAuxOverVoltage', 'faultBoardAuxUnderVoltage',
    'faultBoardOverVoltage', 'faultBoardUnderVoltage', 'faultBoardStackError', 'faultBoardOpenWireDetect'
];

state.hasWarning = warningFlags.some(flag => state[flag] === true);
state.hasFault = faultFlags.some(flag => state[flag] === true);

let activeFaults = [];
warningFlags.forEach(flag => { if (state[flag] === true) activeFaults.push(flag); });
faultFlags.forEach(flag => { if (state[flag] === true) activeFaults.push(flag); });
state.activeFaults = activeFaults;
state.activeFaultCount = activeFaults.length;

flow.set("containerBatteryFaultState", state);
msg.payload = state;
return msg;
